summary: Implemented the grid-sampled patch feature across six files: monai/data/utils.py (iter_patch now yields (patch, coordinates) pairs; set_rnd skips double-underscore attributes), monai/data/grid_dataset.py (new PatchIter; reworked GridPatchDataset with injected patch_iter, transform, and with_coordinates; PatchDataset docstring float fix), monai/data/__init__.py (exports PatchIter), docs/source/data.rst (PatchIter autodoc entry), and tests/test_grid_dataset.py (TestGridPatchDataset with test_shape and test_loading_array). Nothing was run, per instructions; the test file has not been executed. Open choice: start_pos is passed through unchanged without a channel entry prepended, which the user may want to change. The docstring example output is unverified.
